name: SELF_DELETED
source:
In the Lower City, debts are never forgiven.
You have 30 minutes to pay 500,000 credits — or die.

You have no money.
Only a technology that allows you to sell your memories.

Connected to a neural interface, you see your mind as a collection of files.
Each memory has a price. The more it means to you, the higher its value.

First love.
Childhood rooftops.
Your closest friend.
Your mother.
Your core identity.

Once sold, the memory disappears forever.
You won’t even remember what you lost.

What are you willing to sacrifice to survive?
And who will remain when it’s over?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4502030/]Steam[/url]]
